Issue 4540 -- per-release control matrix
generated by make-release-matrix.py; every command below was executed as shown

repro.hlsl          : `static groupshared uint storeTile;`
control-no-static.hlsl : same file, the token `static` removed. The issue
                      itself names this as the correct configuration.
SELFTEST pass = the build emitted a groupshared global of SOME integer type,
                i.e. the module was really produced and read on that build.
IDENT = the !llvm.ident string the build wrote into the very module the
        predicate scores. Releases before ~v1.6 reject `--version`, so this
        -- not a separate invocation -- is what proves which binary answered.

predicate measures nothing. It does not.
